name: Single-Arm Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding a dumbbell in one hand, the other braced on your knee.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side with a slight elbow bend.
Lift until your arm is parallel to the floor, squeezing the rear delt.
Lower slowly. Unilateral work evens out side-to-side imbalances.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the rear delts. Single-Arm Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell) strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
